title: Heartbeat request
description: POST /api/v1/heartbeat (FR-1.2). The host is identified by the credential, never by a field in the body.

schema_version.description: Payload schema version. This directory is version 1.

hostname.description: Hostname as the agent sees it, or null if unreadable. Informational; the credential identifies the host.

uptime_seconds.description: Seconds since the agent process started.

agent_time.description: Agent clock, RFC 3339 UTC. Stored for display only; never used for liveness.

tasks.description: Remote task capabilities (FR-3.1, P3-A01): what this agent can run and what its VM's own configuration enables. The server offers a host a task type only when it is in both supported and enabled, and the host reports local_config valid. Absent means the host offers nothing, as for an agent older than Phase 3. Sent on every heartbeat; it changes only when the agent restarts with another config or version.

catalog_version.description: The catalog_version of the task catalog compiled into the agent (docs/api/tasks/task-catalog.json).

supported.description: Catalog task types this agent version can run, each once. Type ids, not an enum: a newer agent may know types this server does not, and the server ignores those.

enabled.description: Catalog task types the VM's local configuration enables ([tasks] enabled; DEC-14), each once. Empty when local_config is invalid. May list a type the agent does not support yet.

allowed_services.description: The services the VM's local configuration allows restart_service to restart ([tasks] allowed_services; DEC-15), each once, sorted. Empty when local_config is invalid or none is listed. The server leaves out a host whose list lacks the service before sending anything (owner, P3-D01 Q7); the agent still checks its own list when a task arrives.

local_config.description: valid, or invalid when the agent refused the [tasks] section of its config: then nothing is enabled until the owner fixes it on the VM.
